original_card.question: Does a new paid-profile or mixture-ceiling claim have independent source-bound coverage of its actual changed ledger?
methods: Independently reconstruct one changed paid ledger or pooled dual with exact source and model binding.
Check a genuinely uncovered moment implication with a different enclosure method and semantic controls.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Demonstrate independence, source binding, positive cases and semantic failure controls. Name the existing checks and the missing coverage. More digits or another equivalent evaluation of an unchanged root is not by itself new verification coverage.

first_step.inspect: Choose one uncovered implication in #4088 literal mixed fill, #4091 pooled dual/model binding or #4067 changed frame/host bill. #4091 pins an earlier #4088 head: validate word, capacity and stock equivalence before applying that ceiling to the later fill.

Stop after the chosen implication; more digits of an unchanged root are not additional mechanism coverage.

actual_scope: Prove or falsify an all-length concave transport-cost floor for all 128 fixed three-field PR4470 receiver windows, completing the missing implication explicitly left by PR4567.
scope_change_reason: Handoff-first selection follows PR4567 at 50fedd98cda709707e4291c542e20ead96bcc786 rather than repeating the older card examples. Replace bounded shear-word enumeration with a finite-state relaxation and exact all-concave pricing. This remains an independent source-bound paid-invoice audit.
bottleneck_link: A proof that longer words and larger scalar coefficients cannot improve these fixed windows prevents repeated finite searches and identifies changed boundary or field contracts as the remaining routes.
stop_rule: Stop after source-bound closure of all 128 windows and containment/cost controls, or report any relaxed counterexample. No larger-window search, physical supplier replay or frontier change.

open_questions.first_step: Specify one fourth-field entrance/exit and ownership contract, then derive its complete optimistic transport and cleanup state graph.
open_questions.blocked_by: No fourth-field allowance is supplied; a positive relaxation still requires endpoint, geometric and physical validation.

open_questions.question: Can a joint window save paid work when its internal boundary is allowed to move?

open_questions.blocked_by: A changed caller contract and new source-bound geometry are required; single-window gains cannot be added.
